related.title: IBM Bivariate Bicycle：qLDPC 編碼率與完整資源
related.titleEn: IBM bivariate bicycle codes: qLDPC rate and complete resources
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：品質報告必須同時給接受率、原始態消耗與假設，不能只報被選出的最佳輸出。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Report acceptance, consumption and assumptions with quality rather than only selected outputs. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 區分數學碼的n/k與加入校驗、路由後的每邏輯位元成本。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish mathematicaln/k from physical cost after checks and routing.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。輸入錯誤率p=0.01，每批15個輸入；此處先只算被接受輸出的近似錯誤。 p出≈35×0.01³。 代入 35*0.01**3，得到 3.5e-05 accepted-output error probability。採理想15-to-1的低p教學近似p出≈35p入³；忽略Clifford錯誤與高階項，非任意p都適用。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。以144資料、144校驗、12邏輯的算例練習資源帳本，先不算路由。 每邏輯成本=(144+144)/12。 代入 (144+144)/12，得到 24 physical qubits/logical qubit。每邏輯成本=(資料+校驗+路由)/k；不同碼距和雜訊模型不能只靠此比值比較可靠度。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Input errorp=0.01,15 inputs per batch; initially estimate accepted-output error only. pout≈35×0.01³. Substituting 35*0.01**3 gives 3.5e-05 accepted-output error probability. Use the low-p ideal15-to-1 approximationpout≈35pin³, excludingClifford errors and higher orders. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Use an illustrative ledger with144 data,144 checks and12 logical qubits, initially excluding routing. Cost per logical=(144+144)/12. Substituting (144+144)/12 gives 24 physical qubits/logical qubit. Cost per logical=(data+checks+routing)/k; reliability comparisons also require matched distances and noise models. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。擬合α=0.99，序列長度含1、10、20、50、100；A、B自由擬合。 EPC=(1−0.99)/2。 代入 (1-0.99)/2，得到 0.005 error/Clifford。單量子位元去極化模型下EPC=(1−α)/2，擬合P(m)=Aα^m+B；A與B吸收部分SPAM，不保證消除所有漂移。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Input errorp=0.01,15 inputs per batch; initially estimate accepted-output error only. pout≈35×0.01³. Substituting 35*0.01**3 gives 3.5e-05 accepted-output error probability. Use the low-p ideal15-to-1 approximationpout≈35pin³, excludingClifford errors and higher orders. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Fitα=0.99 using lengths1,10,20,50,100 with freeA/B. EPC=(1−0.99)/2. Substituting (1-0.99)/2 gives 0.005 error/Clifford. For a one-qubit depolarizing modelEPC=(1−α)/2 withP(m)=Aα^m+B;A/B absorb someSPAM but not all drift. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
